title: Week 34 Mastery Quiz

questions.question: Which definition best matches “market economy”?
options: Employers’ willingness and ability to hire workers at different compensation levels.
A system relying heavily on decentralized exchange, prices, private choice, and competition.
The labor force as a percentage of the civilian noninstitutional working-age population.
A stated complaint alleging an abuse, injury, or violation of a principle.
questions.explanation: Market economy means a system relying heavily on decentralized exchange, prices, private choice, and competition.
choices: Employers’ willingness and ability to hire workers at different compensation levels.
A system relying heavily on decentralized exchange, prices, private choice, and competition.
The labor force as a percentage of the civilian noninstitutional working-age population.
A stated complaint alleging an abuse, injury, or violation of a principle.

options: A system in which political authorities make major production and allocation decisions through directives and plans.
How income, wealth, consumption, or opportunity is divided across people and groups.
The rate charged on eligible borrowing from Federal Reserve lending facilities.
The process through which one condition is expected to produce another.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “mixed economy”?
options: A system combining markets with public regulation, provision, taxation, and social insurance.
Knowledge and skills needed to understand institutions, rights, responsibilities, and public decisions.
A tax whose burden consumes a larger share of lower income than higher income.
The share of an eligible or registered population that casts a ballot.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “property right”?
options: The agreement creating proportional representation in the House and equal state representation in the Senate.
Uncertainty arising because a survey measures a sample rather than the entire population.
A tradition holding that moral principles can be discovered through reason and apply beyond enacted rules.
A legally recognized authority to use, exclude, transfer, or benefit from an asset subject to law.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “social insurance”?
options: Public programs pooling risks such as unemployment, disability, health cost, or old-age income.
An opponent or critic of ratification who feared centralized power and demanded stronger protections for liberty.
The quantities producers are willing and able to sell at different prices during a stated period.
The distribution of a tax’s economic burden between buyers and sellers.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “political economy”?
options: Study of how political institutions, power, law, and economic systems interact.
An argument about what government should do, based on goals, evidence, feasibility, and tradeoffs.
A person who organizes resources, bears uncertainty, and develops products, services, or processes.
Workers’ willingness and ability to offer labor at different compensation levels.

questions.question: Which action best demonstrates mastery of the Week 34 inquiry?
options: A student accepts the first available claim or offer without checking the source, terms, evidence, or consequences.
A student compares actual institutions and outcomes rather than treating “capitalism,” “socialism,” or “mixed economy” as self-explanatory labels.
A student relies on political identity, advertising, or personal preference as a substitute for documented analysis.
A student selects an answer only because it sounds confident, even when the record is incomplete or contradictory.
questions.explanation: A student compares actual institutions and outcomes rather than treating “capitalism,” “socialism,” or “mixed economy” as self-explanatory labels.
